cohort: 12 pregnant women who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 at admission to a maternity hospital between March 16 and July 31, 2020
finding: Among hospitalized pregnant women positive for SARS-CoV-2, most were asymptomatic or had mild illness, and there were no cases of vertical transmission.
mod_finding: Cesarean section indications were obstetric and not related to SARS-CoV-2 infection.
gest_age: Varied, one stillbirth at 20 weeks gestation
